changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE site_feedback ( id varchar(36) PRIMARY KEY, user_id bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES store_users(id), request_id varchar(36) NOT NULL, author varchar(80) NOT NULL, kind varchar(16) NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('REVIEW','ISSUE','IDEA')), body varchar(3000) NOT NULL, public_consent boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, state varchar(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING' CHECK (state IN ('PENDING','PUBLISHED','ARCHIVED')), created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, UNIQUE(user_id,request_id), CHECK (state <> 'PUBLISHED' OR public_consent=TRUE) ); CREATE INDEX site_feedback_state_date ON site_feedback(state,created_at); CREATE INDEX site_feedback_user_date ON site_feedback(user_id,created_at);
